title: Pet Display
description: Vanilla inspired inventory slot to show equipped pet for Hypixel Skyblock
body:
# Pet Display

Pet Display is a Hypixel Skyblock quality of life mod that shows your currently active pet in the inventory screen.

## Installation guide
### Requires:
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Hypixel API](https://modrinth.com/mod/hypixel-mod-api)

### Optional:
[SkyCubed](https://modrinth.com/mod/skycubed)
